2121943803015901691.en_summary: StockSavvyShay: Deutsche Bank sees $ASTS revenue growing to $4.5B by 2030 with EBITDA margins reaching 80% as the constellation scales and additional subscribers become much more profitable. What makes the ramp interesting is that government and other contracts account for ~73% of 2027 revenue before commercial subscriptions really accelerate in 2028 while existing cash, J-LEO support and planned financing could largely cover ~$4.6B of modeled cash burn before FCF turns positive in 2029. Blacklift adds another opportunity by eventually giving AST control over launches carrying ~5 BlueBirds at a time.
2121943803015901691.zh_summary: StockSavvyShay：德意志銀行看到 $ASTS 收入到 2030 年增長至 45 億美元，EBITDA 利潤率達到 80%，隨著星座擴展和額外訂戶變得更加有利可圖。使這次上升有趣的是，政府和其他合約佔 2027 年收入約 73%，然後商業訂閱在 2028 年真正加速，而現有現金、J-LEO 支持和計劃融資可以 largely 覆蓋約 46 億美元的模擬現金消耗，直到 2029 年自由現金流轉正。Blacklift 通過最終給予 AST 對一次攜帶約 5 顆 BlueBirds 的發射控制增加另一個機會。

ticker_notes.ASTS: DB sees revenue to $4.5B by 2030, EBITDA margins 80%, gov contracts ~73% of 2027 rev, cash burn coverage to FCF positive 2029
